mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_connector_update_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, instance_id, fingerprint) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{instance}, #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, instance_id, fingerprint FROM nw_connector_update_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
